scripts.dev:api: cross-env PORT=8080 NODE_ENV=development pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev
scripts.dev:web: cross-env PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ API_PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @workspace/smart-home run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:web: cross-env PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/smart-home run build
scripts.start: cross-env PORT=8080 NODE_ENV=production PUBLIC_DIR=../smart-home/dist/public pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.preview: cross-env PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ API_PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @workspace/smart-home run serve
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run typecheck
